title: Why did I reach my sending limit?
summary: Explains why you may have reached a sending limit due to daily ($750) or monthly ($7,500) caps for new accounts, smaller payments totaling up to the remaining allowance, or a completed payment reducing available capacity below your next attempt. It also tells you how to confirm via the Everyone Pay screen and review recent outgoing payments, and what to do next (wait, reduce amount, or request a higher limit).
faqs: What are the daily and monthly sending caps for new accounts ($750/$7,500)?
Why would a series of smaller payments cause me to hit my limit?
How can I check my remaining daily and monthly availability?
How can I tell which recent outgoing payments contributed to the limit?
What should I do if my completed payment reduced my available capacity?
Can I request a higher limit, and when should I try again?
